name: Mira Fenwick
proficiencies: Daggers, darts, slings, quarterstaffs, light crossbows
bio: A practical traveling scholar who collects stories about vanished libraries. Example built with 2014 rules; spell descriptions are short play reminders.

traits.name: Arcane Recovery
traits.description: Once per day after a short rest, recover expended spell slots totaling up to 2 levels; none may be level 6 or higher.

traits.name: Sculpt Spells
traits.description: When casting an evocation spell affecting creatures you can see, choose up to 1 + spell level of them. They automatically succeed on their saving throws and take no damage if they would normally take half.

attacks.name: Fire Bolt
attacks.description: A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it is not worn or carried.

equipment.name: Spellbook
equipment.description: Contains the eight leveled spells listed below.

equipment.name: Explorer's pack
equipment.description: Use the 2014 equipment list for contents.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: Use the Fire Bolt attack on the Core tab: +5 to hit, 1d10 fire.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: One object sheds bright light for 20 feet and dim light for 20 more. A hostile holder can make a Dexterity save to avoid the spell.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: Create a spectral hand; use your action to manipulate a small object. It cannot attack, activate magic items, or carry more than 10 pounds.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: Create three darts, each dealing 1d4+1 force damage to a visible creature you choose. Darts strike simultaneously.
spells.higher_levels: One additional dart per slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Shield
spells.casting_time: 1 reaction, when hit by an attack or targeted by magic missile
spells.description: Gain +5 AC until the start of your next turn, including against the triggering attack, and take no damage from magic missile.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.description: A willing unarmored creature's base AC becomes 13 + Dexterity modifier. Manually set Mira's custom AC to 15 while active.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: Sense magic within 30 feet; use an action to see an aura around a visible magical creature or object and learn its school, if any. Barriers can block detection.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: Creatures in the cone make a Dexterity save against DC 13, taking 3d6 fire on a failure or half on success. Unattended flammable objects ignite.
spells.higher_levels: Add 1d6 fire per slot level above 1st.

spells.name: Find Familiar
spells.materials: 10 gp of charcoal, incense, and herbs, consumed in a brass brazier
spells.description: Summon an animal-form spirit familiar. It acts independently and cannot attack. Consult the 2014 spell for senses, touch-spell delivery, forms, and dismissal.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.description: Make three separate ranged spell attacks at +5 to hit. Each hit deals 2d6 fire damage. Choose targets separately.
spells.higher_levels: One additional ray per slot level above 2nd.
